capabilities: Rank notes by open count and active reading time over any date range
Roll up visit statistics by note tags
Show weekly and monthly trending notes and tags with rank movement icons
Import visit history from the Note Open Tracker Plus plugin
Back up, prune, and reset tracker data
disambiguation: Not a web-browser history tool; it tracks which vault notes you open and how long you actively read them.
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that a second import run double-counts overlapping events, and that data stays local with no network requests.
intentEvidence: Import from the Note Open Tracker Plus plugin, so switching does not cost you your history.
problem: Obsidian gives no statistics on which notes you actually revisit and read, so you cannot tell which notes deserve the next summarization pass.

relations.evidence: Import from the Note Open Tracker Plus plugin, so switching does not cost you your history.

summary: Usage-tracking plugin that ranks notes by open count and active reading time over selectable date ranges to find progressive summarization candidates.
